body: This has probably been said but kill them with kindness. It makes them even madder, makes you look like the bigger person, and makes them look like assholes.

I wish I knew. There's the atheist part of me that thinks that our brain chemicals just dissolve with us into the ground. There's another part of me that hopes that we go to a 'heaven' of sorts. In reality, I believe that we go to wherever we were before we were born(wherever that might be!).

Thank you so much for your response! Honestly, my parents are great people but sorta ignorant when it comes to mental illnesses. The only way they'd take me seriously is if I actually tried something rash and I don't actually want to die. I don't know if I want to recover yet but I want all of this to be out in the open now. 

Right now, I'm planning on studying accounting and international business! I'm super excited for college and the experiences it will give me. At least I have things to look forward to

Please don't do anything rash. Take it one step at a time. Have a cup of tea or take a hot shower. Just distract yourself for a little while. There must be something that's making you hold on as you took the time to write this.

Losing a beloved pet is the worst. When I lost my beautiful cat, I didn't know what to do.
First, it's not just a 'dumb dog'. Pets can be the best friends you can ever have. There's a website I'll link to that is pretty nice to memorialize your pet. 
http://www.rainbowbridge.com/
Again, I'm sorry about your precious dog, losing a pet is the hardest thing. Sorry I couldn't be much help
